title: Canonical thinking pipeline with model(suffix) overrides and per-provider appliers

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

body:
Part of #720 (sub-issue). Case study: [docs/case-studies/issue-720](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-720-99e7abc4e6c1/docs/case-studies/issue-720/README.md).

## Summary
Router maps thinking controls (`thinking.budget_tokens`, `reasoning_effort`, Gemini `thinkingConfig`) inside each adapter (22 source files). CLIProxyAPI parses a `model(suffix)` override (`gpt-5(high)`, `claude-sonnet(16384)`, `model(none)`, `model(-1)` auto) into a canonical `ThinkingConfig` and applies it per target provider with one `ApplyThinking(body, model, from, to, providerKey)` function, covered by five end-to-end matrices. Centralising this removes the most frequent class of cross-protocol client breakage.

Case study: `docs/case-studies/issue-720/solution-plans.md` § C.

## Proposal
1. New module `src/thinking/`: `parse_suffix` (`ParseSuffix`/`ParseNumericSuffix`/`ParseSpecialSuffix`/`ParseLevelSuffix` grammar), canonical `ThinkingConfig { mode: Off | Auto | Budget(u32) | Level(Low|Medium|High|…) }`, and per-target appliers for Anthropic, OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Gemini, Vertex, Codex, Qwen.
2. Appliers consult the model-truth contract for supported ranges and clamp or drop with a logged reason.
3. Adapters call the module; signature replay stays where it is.
4. Document the suffix grammar in `README.md` and `docs/model-truth-contract.md`.

## Tests
Port `TestThinkingE2EMatrix_Suffix`, `_Body`, `_ProviderTargets`, `_InteractionsMatrix`, `_ClaudeAdaptive_Body` as table-driven tests with the upstream vectors (MIT, attributed in the file header). `proptest` round-trip on the parser. Every existing adapter test keeps passing.

## Prior art
CLIProxyAPI `internal/thinking/suffix.go`, `apply.go`, `test/thinking_conversion_test.go`.

## Compatibility
Suffix parsing is additive; model names without a suffix are untouched. Body-level controls keep their current precedence.
